profile.headline: Information Systems Coordinator at School District of Lee County
profile.summary:
As a PeopleSoft Design Architect at General Electric, I have enjoyed the challenge of researching, identifying and implementing innovative design solutions for PeopleSoft Time & Labor, Payroll, and Benefits Administration. Beginning with the implementation of PeopleSoft payroll from a mainframe legacy system in 2000, I have more than ten years of experience with implementations and upgrades. Most recently, I have expanded my payroll knowledge to include the pending implementation of Canadian payroll on version 9.2. 

In addition to my PeopleSoft experience, I have nearly two decades of experience with payroll and benefits delivering accurate and timely payroll to ~135,000 active employees and ~285,000 pensioners. Some of my primary responsibilities include web based self-service applications such as Federal and state withholding updates, eW-2, e1099 and online pay summary. I also provide functional system analysis and support for ongoing production operations.
